preconditions.expression: isinstance(palindrome, str) and 1 <= len(palindrome) <= 1000 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in palindrome)
preconditions.description: Input is a non-empty string of lowercase English letters with length between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == 0 if len(palindrome) == 1 else len(return_value) == len(palindrome)
postconditions.description: Output is either empty (if input length is 1) or has the same length as input.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' or (return_value != return_value[::-1] and all(return_value[i] == palindrome[i] for i in range(len(palindrome)) if i != modified_index))
postconditions.description: Output is either empty or a non-palindrome string that differs from input by exactly one character.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '' or (return_value == min(candidate for candidate in generate_candidates(palindrome) if candidate != candidate[::-1]))
postconditions.description: Output is the lexicographically smallest possible non-palindrome string obtainable by changing exactly one character in input.
